1.consolidated_definition: Referido a un gallo de pelea, que, después de tirar la patada, cae con todo su cuerpo y no sobre sus patas debido a un entrenamiento incompleto.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Referring to a fighting rooster that, after kicking, falls with its entire body and not on its legs due to incomplete training.
